summary: Improve loan assessment, branch controls and PAR30 follow-up with practical microfinance training. Review the five-day course outline.
lede: Microfinance best practices training helps managers, credit supervisors and loan officers strengthen client assessment and branch-level credit control. Participants practise reviewing loan files, assessing household cash flow, documenting approvals, monitoring arrears and planning respectful collection follow-up. They also develop a branch review checklist and early-warning action plan using PAR30, operational self-sufficiency and complaint records.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for microfinance professionals who make, supervise or review lending decisions and need practical ways to improve credit-file discipline, client treatment and branch portfolio oversight.
prerequisites: Working knowledge of microfinance lending or branch operations is expected. No coding or programming is required.
